caveats:
Uniform growth rate is used for admin 3 units in the same Region (admin 1).
Small differences in totals between administrative levels are caused by rounding.

methodology_other: The 2026 population estimates are based on the Central Statistics Agency (CSA) 2025 population projections at Administrative Level 3, as well as CSA town population estimates. Special enumeration woredas are included within their respective regions. Woredas in the Contested Areas are categorized based on the contested area classification used for this analysis. Population growth rates were calculated by comparing the July 2025 CSA projections with the 2024 projections at admin1 level. The 2026 population projections were then derived by applying the calculated growth rates to the 2025 projections for each woreda, disaggregated by sex and age.
name: cod-ps-eth
notes:
Ethiopia administrative level 0-3 sex and age disaggregated projected 2026 population statistics.

REFERENCE YEAR:  2025

These tables are suitable for database or GIS linkage to the [Ethiopia - Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-eth).
